name: Takamori (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Takamori town emblem in white: a crown-like device above a ring enclosing a small ring.
history: Municipal flag of Takamori, a town in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Takamori town emblem — a crown-like device above a ring enclosing a small ring
